title: AGENTSAFE: A UNIFIED FRAMEWORK FOR ETHICAL ASSURANCE AND GOVERNANCE IN AGENTIC AI
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on a general governance framework for agentic AI systems.
